notes: Default reuses HeuristicSelector and RuleStop; no network/model downloads.
passed required checks need evidence_ids referencing request.evidence; otherwise treated unknown.
covers means possible coverage, never a successful observation.
All attempted kind+arguments are deduplicated, including not_sent. Unknown/prepared receipts block new planning.
Omitted budget dimensions are unlimited for policy only; the host retains all hard limits.
Unknown cost in a limited dimension excludes that action; do not invent zero.
document_search is exactly one explicit provider and one query/terms set; tool_calls=1.
Evidence payloads may have extra provenance fields; the policy only reads IDs.

example.question: Which clinical evidence supports this mechanism?

history_statuses.prepared: reserved but dispatch not yet reconciled; blocks further actions
history_statuses.sent: dispatched, waiting for result; blocks further actions
history_statuses.unknown: dispatch outcome uncertain; blocks all new planning, never retry with a new id
history_statuses.completed: finished, consumed attempt; new_evidence_ids describes actual receipt
history_statuses.failed: confirmed finished unsuccessfully; consumed attempt, no automatic retry
history_statuses.not_sent: confirmed no dispatch; still no automatic retry under this contract

history_shape.action_id: unique attempt id; supply only the latest receipt for each attempt
history_shape.new_evidence_ids: optional list of actual new evidence IDs

kind_mapping.entity_relations: entity_lookup; list relation types of already grounded entity, not name disambiguation

projection: Required checks with evidence refs become external observable sufficiency; covers overlap with unmet checks and actual estimated costs become existing 18 action features. No synthetic triples are constructed. Graph-specific checkpoints are not compatible with this external feature schema.
